paper_metadata.title: Partitioning and diffusion of transition metal solutes in ternary model Ni-based single crystal superalloys

evidence.quote: Partitioning and diffusion of transition metal solutes can significantly affect the coarsening rate of γ' precipitates in Ni-based single crystal superalloys.
For ternary model Ni-based single crystal superalloys, the 3d solutes (except Ti) partition to the matrix phase, whereas 4d and 5d solutes (except Ru, Rh, and Ir) prefer γ' precipitates.
